Squads, Leaders & Synergies

Squads of 4: Leader skills, type Synergies, Shatter and Guarded.

Your party is a squad of 4. Every squad member is a bit tougher than a lone fighter (HP ×1.25, Attack and Sp. Atk ×1.05).

  • Leader skill: your slot-1 Pokémon gives the whole squad its skill.
  • Synergies: any 2 of a type in the squad (dual types count for both) light that type's Synergy. One per type.
  • Shatter: a Break plus a DPS. When the Break cracks something, the DPS's next hit within 2 turns deals ×1.5 (Zoom Lens: ×2).
  • Guarded: a Support in the squad. Works like Sturdy: the first hit (or damage tick) that would knock your Pokémon out leaves it at 1 HP instead, and it still gets its move that turn (twice a fight with Light Clay). In raids and friend battles it saves the Pokémon after the turn, as before.
  • King's Rock in slot 1: the Leader skill is 25% stronger (on/off skills give +10% squad damage instead). Metronome in slot 1: the one fighting hits 3% harder each turn it stays in, up to +30%.

Leader skills

About 40 Pokémon (and their Megas) have a signature skill. Everyone else leads with their first type: that type's moves +15% for the squad (Rare +18%, Legendary +22%), plus a little from its role: DPS "and every hit +5%", Break "and Break cracks shields 25% harder", Support "and the squad heals 2% each turn".
